title: Sinov: 500 qator, 3 yashirin muammo
caption: 🔍 500 qator, 3 ta yashirin muammo Rahbar so'radi: «Murojaatlar bilan ishlashda ahvol qanday?» Qo'lingizda bir yillik reestr — 500 qator. 📎 Keyingi xabarda murojaatlar_2025.xlsx — o'ylab topilgan idoraning reestri. Ichiga ataylab 3 ta muammo yashirilgan: 1️⃣ Bitta bo'lim muddatni boshqalardan bir necha barobar ko'p buzadi. Umumiy foizga qarasangiz — hammasi joyida. 2️⃣ Bir oyda murojaatlar keskin ko'paygan, sababi — bitta mavzu. 3️⃣ Ayrim murojaatlar ikki marta ro'yxatga olingan. ✍️ Vazifa: Excelda qo'lda topib ko'ring va vaqtni belgilang: qaysi bo'lim, qaysi oy, nechta takror? Javobingizni izohda yozing. Ertaga shu ishni AI bilan qilamiz va javoblarni solishtiramiz. 💡 Bugungi yangi bilim: AI ga jadvalni matn qilib ko'chirish shart emas. Faylning o'zini bersangiz, u faylni ochib, ichida ishlaydi. 🎁 Olib keting: mashq fayli murojaatlar_2025.xlsx. Bu haftaning hamma darsi shu faylda. ➖➖➖ {{CHANNEL}} #sinov
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Style: clean paper-cut editorial illustration — flat layered shapes with soft shadows, like a neatly filled-in office form. Warm off-white paper background (#F5F2E9), deep navy ink (#141C2B) and one accent colour (#2F5BEA). Calm, trustworthy, no clutter.

1) Top-left: a small solid #2F5BEA rounded rectangle with white bold uppercase monospace text "HAFTA SINOVI".
2) Center: a tall stack of paper registry sheets with a magnifying glass over it; three small accent-coloured flags stick out of the stack at different heights. Paper-cut style, matte, generous empty space around it. No people's faces, no real logos, no state emblems or flags.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold navy headline in a characterful grotesque sans-serif, at most three lines: "Qo'lda topa olasizmi?"
4) Bottom, above a thin hairline: left small monospace navy text "AI darslar".

Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes. No other text, no watermarks.
notes: Fayldagi javoblar (tozalangan 488 qator bo'yicha): Ruxsatnomalar bo'limi — muddatida 66 %, qolganlar 93 %, umumiy 88 %; sentabr — 77 ta murojaat (boshqa oylarda o'rtacha 37), shundan 41 tasi «Elektron xizmat ishlamayapti»; takror — 12 ta. Javoblar seshanba postida spoyler ostida.

attachments.caption: 📎 Hafta mashq fayli. O'ylab topilgan ma'lumot — haqiqiy idora yoki shaxslarga aloqasi yo'q. {{CHANNEL}}
